In the pre-pandemic days of 2019, two visionary students from Leiden University, Rafael Jezior and Dennis de Beeld, also known as 'Mr. White' and 'Mr. Black', envisioned a game that would bring the intricate world of immunology to the masses. Their goal? To make science cool, intuitive, and visually appealing. ImmunoWars was born out of a passion for science and a desire to combat ignorance and misinformation in a fun and engaging way.
